sources.title: Fiverr to lay off 30% of workforce
sources.description: Most of the 250 employees who will lose their jobs are based in Israel.

sources.title: Freelance platform Fiverr cuts 30% of staff in AI restructuring
sources.description: Marketplace platform cuts 250 jobs in restructuring aimed at embedding artificial intelligence at the core of its operations.

sources.title: Fiverr cuts 250 staff, re-enters "startup mode" by going all-in on AI
sources.description: Named after the $5 odd jobs once available through the service, Fiverr connects copywriters, graphic designers, coders, and marketing consultants, among others, to paying clients.
